title: Magnetic-Bead cDNA Amplification

source_steps.summary: Place each tube of bead-bound template-switched cDNA input material on the high position of the magnetic rack.
Incubate until the solution clears, about 2 minutes. If beads have settled, pipette mix to resuspend them so they separate appropriately.
While still on the magnetic rack, remove and discard the supernatant.
While still on the magnetic rack, add 125 uL of Wash Buffer 3 to each tube.
Incubate for 1 minute at room temperature.
While still on the magnetic rack, remove and discard Wash Buffer 3.
Remove the tube(s) from the magnetic rack.
Fully resuspend each bead pellet with 100 uL of the Amplification Master Mix.
Determine the number of PCR cycles required for cDNA amplification based on input cell or nuclei count and sample type.
Place the tube(s) into a thermocycler and run the cDNA Amplification program.
